subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 4/7] exportfs/mountd/exportd: get export features from the netlink policy

reviews.author: Benjamin Coddington
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the NFSEXP_SECINFO_FLAGS value is not being used anywhere after it's copied from the export_policy_dump, and asked if it's needed elsewhere.
reviews.raw_body:
^^ the value gets copied in from the export_policy_dump, but never used.  Do
you need this somewhere else?

Ben

reviews.author: Jeff Layton (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged a concern about unused code in the patch series, explained that it will be addressed in follow-on patches for new r/wiomode= export options, and confirmed that the field will be dropped from this patch.
reviews.raw_body:
Good catch — you're right, nothing in this series reads it back.

I have some follow-on patches that will add new r/wiomode= export
options. This field will get used when those get added. I'll plan to
drop that field here and add it back as part of the iomode series.

Thanks,
-- 
Jeff Layton <jlayton@kernel.org>

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch updates the NFS utilities to retrieve export features from the netlink policy instead of reading them from /proc/fs/nfsd/export_features. It adds a new function nfsd_export_policy_query() that uses the netlink interface to dump the SET_REQS policy and fills a struct with the maximum attribute value. The patch also introduces set_export_features() and nfsd_nl_load_export_features() functions to seed export features from the policy, and modifies get_export_features() to use the new functions if possible. If the netlink interface is unavailable, get_export_features() still reads /proc/fs/nfsd/export_features as before.
